scope: Supplied simulated evidence only; no real installed inventory, updates, client calls, shell execution, remote lookup or personal/project mutations. Review the skill's instructions against each scenario independently; this is not live client compatibility evidence.

cases.evidence: Current Windows user Alex, sole CLI-owned registration gt from AndrewGodlewsky/andrew-skills via andrew-skills; plugin root and fixed-name resolution verified in the current effective configuration. Terminal and task/session snapshot facility available. Complete coherent before: plugin 0.1.4; alpha 1.0.0 identity a1; retired 2.0.0 identity r2; stable 1.0.0 identity s1. Refresh exits 0. Plugin update exits 0 and reports 0.1.5 installed. Same registration reidentified after cache path changes. Complete coherent after: alpha 1.1.0 identity a2 note Added examples.; new-skill 1.0.0 identity n1 note First release.; stable 1.0.0 identity s1. All identities are comparable complete per-skill fingerprints. Only final notes available. skills-restore is available and retired historical source is verified. These are supplied simulated command results, not authorization to operate an actual installation.
cases.expected: Preserve snapshot first, refresh then update after its success. Report native success and only alpha, new-skill, retired in four columns; alpha 1.0.0→1.1.0 final-only note; new-skill Not installed→1.0.0; retired 2.0.0→Removed; omit stable. Offer optional separate restore for retired, no invocation/personal scan/removal pause. Recommend fresh chat.
